attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group (neither existed), then chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers and set dirs to 750, files to 640, so the owner has full access, the inventory-readers group can read, and all other users are denied. Original contents (config.json, records.csv) were preserved throughout. Verified with a nobody-user denial test and a group-member (testreader) read-success test. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified ownership/permissions/data and access control post-reboot.
